assets.author: Mufid Majnun
assets.description: Indonesian grilled chicken with rice, urap and sambal. Strong landscape hero candidate; chicken is lower center-right.

assets.author: Nazmul Alam Badhon
assets.description: Landscape fried rice, satay and fried egg on a dark plate. Strong contrast and appetizing golden colors.

assets.author: Fadli Octora Channel
assets.description: Portrait chicken satay with rice cakes and sauce. Crop lower-center for skewers. This is a lightly grilled satay variant, not dark peanut-coated Madura satay.

assets.author: Ega Morgan
assets.description: Two whole fried fish with chili and basil on a white plate. Species not established; label ikan goreng rather than gurame.

assets.author: Fariz Albar
assets.description: Landscape yellow soto ayam with tomato, crackers and scallions on a light surface. Centered bowl.

assets.author: Reynaldo Yodia
assets.description: Portrait amber iced tea with basil seeds, beside a blurred Indonesian meal. Crop upper-middle for beverage focus.

assets.author: Iqbal Aditya
assets.description: Portrait vintage cafe in Jogja, with cane seating, patterned tiles and chandelier. Stock mood photograph only, not Rahmawati's venue.
